entities.summary: Solveig Heilo (b. 1981-12-24, Bærum Municipality) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Bærum Municipality and Norway. Known in the fields of norway, composers & musicians, europe.
